newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodia to be ASEAN member by July, official says.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia to be ASEAN member by July, official says.

text.p: Indonesian Foreign Minister Ali Alatas has informed Cambodia's leaders that the country will be admitted to the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) in July, a top Cambodian official said on Tuesday.

"It is confirmed. We will be an ASEAN member by July," co-Minister of the Council of Ministers Sok An told reporters after a meeting with Alatas, Indonesian President Suharto and Cambodian co-Premiers Prince Norodom Ranariddh and Hun Sen.

Sok An said Alatas had told the co-premiers the news in a briefing of the results of the ASEAN-European Union meeting in Singapore last week. At present, Cambodia holds observer status in the seven-member grouping.
Suharto arrived in Phnom Penh on Monday for a three-day visit as part of a regional tour that also includes Laos and Burma.
The announcement appears to indicate that Laos and Burma, also observer nations, would also become full members in July as the grouping celebrates its 30th anniversary.
The regional club has said Cambodia, Laos and Burma would be admitted simultaneously to ASEAN, which groups Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.
